items.title: John Abercrombie interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 19, 2001
items.q: I heard some bands, that band Mountain one time with Leslie West, it was so loud my stomach was rumbling. I had to leave.

ctx.x: No I never did. I’m surprised I never did because I saw so many great jazz musicians and I was in that scene playing with fusion bands but I never got to see a lot of the great rock players. I played opposite Chicago once, I remember that, and that was really enjoyable and I heard some bands, that band Mountain one time with Leslie West, it was so loud my stomach was rumbling. I had to leave. It sounded good but I remember it was in the Village Gate and it was just like the music had me pinned against the wall.
Have you ever had any trouble with playing the fusion type thing and volume and all that?
